name: Sheet
summary: Mobile-flavor bottom-anchored modal with optional detents (half / large / full). The Apple HIG / iOS 'sheet'. Distinct from Drawer (side, desktop-flavor), Dialog (centered, decision), Popover (anchored, small). On desktop, prefer Drawer side='right'; Sheet is reserved for mobile and tablet portrait.

detents.description: large: ~70vh single detent (most common). medium-large: two detents at 50vh + 90vh; users drag the handle to switch. full: 100vh — equivalent to a route.

handle.description: Visible drag handle at the top. Always render on iOS-flavor; optional on Android-flavor.

footer.description: Sticky footer with primary action; the sheet's primary CTA should never scroll out of view.

dismissible.description: Drag-to-dismiss + scrim-click + Escape. False locks the sheet open.

padding.description: default applies inset-lg; none lets the content take full width (image gallery, full-bleed cards).

wcag: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (intentional, with visible exit)
rules: Drag handle has aria-label='Drag to resize'. Keyboard users use ArrowUp / ArrowDown on the handle to step through detents.
Sheet content gets aria-labelledby={titleId} when a title is rendered.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the slide-up; render the sheet at its final detent with a fade.
On the smallest detent (medium-large half), the content area is scrollable; primary CTA stays pinned via the footer slot.

do: Render handle by default — it's the gesture affordance.
Use one detent unless the sheet has structurally different content at the two heights.
Pin primary actions in the footer.
Render above the safe-area-inset-bottom (home indicator) so the affordance isn't clipped.
Use a clear back-arrow + 'Close' button in the header for non-keyboard users on desktop tablets.
dont: Don't use Sheet on desktop — use Drawer.
Don't put primary actions in a scrollable region — they must be pinned.
Don't let drag-to-dismiss fire without a confirmation when the user has unsaved input.

changelog.note: Initial Sheet contract. Single + two-detent + full-height variants. iOS-flavor drag handle.
